publications_org_archived_idx.name: publications_org_archived_idx
publications_org_archived_idx.where: "publications"."archived_at" is not null and "publications"."removed_at" is null

publications_live_chk.name: publications_live_chk
publications_live_chk.value: "publications"."removed_at" is not null or ("publications"."original_text" is not null and "publications"."available_on" is not null)

publications_tombstone_chk.name: publications_tombstone_chk
publications_tombstone_chk.value:
"publications"."removed_at" is null or (
        "publications"."archived_at" is not null
        and "publications"."original_text" is null and "publications"."raw_payload" is null and "publications"."recipients" is null
        and "publications"."process_number" is null and "publications"."process_mask" is null
        and "publications"."notes" is null and "publications"."action_note" is null and "publications"."source_url" is null
      )
